description: 전북특별자치도_시군별 재난 예비경보시설 현황 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 전북특별자치도. 전북특별자치도 내에 설치된 각종 재난 예비경보시설의 시군별 현황을 정리한 데이터입니다. 이 자료는 하천 수위 관측소, 자동우량계, 재난감시 CCTV 등 재난을 사전에 감지하는 시설과, 산간 계곡이나 마을에 위험 상황을 알리는 자동 음성 통보 시스템, 재해 문자 전광판 등 경보를 전파하는 시설의 수량을 포... Coverage: 전북특별자치도. The portal files it under the publisher 전북특별자치도. Its tags are 재난예경보, 조기경보시스템, 재난안전, 방재시설, 홍수통제. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-08-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
